import pandas as pd
from sklearn.preprocessing import MinMaxScaler
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(data):
    df = pd.DataFrame(data)

    if df.empty:
        fig, ax = plt.subplots()
        df["Average"] = pd.Series(dtype=float)
        return df, ax

    scaler = MinMaxScaler()
    scaled_values = scaler.fit_transform(df)

    normalized_df = pd.DataFrame(scaled_values, columns=df.columns, index=df.index)
    normalized_df["Average"] = normalized_df.mean(axis=1)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4))
    ax.bar(normalized_df.index.astype(str), normalized_df["Average"], color="steelblue")
    ax.set_xlabel("Row")
    ax.set_ylabel("Average")
    ax.set_title("Average of MinMax-Normalized Rows")
    plt.tight_layout()

    return normalized_df, ax
